name: UTAS Tax Clinic
summary: Free tax help in Hobart, including tax returns and ATO disputes, for people in financial hardship.
key: Free professional tax services for eligible taxpayers.
who: Taxpayers facing financial hardship, in a dispute with the ATO, or with a tax debt to negotiate.
how: Apply online, phone +61 3 6226 6118 or email tax.clinic@utas.edu.au.
catches: Hobart office, 157 Elizabeth Street, open Tuesday to Thursday. Closed over summer.
